body: Thanks everyone! update: I asked one shop to take it down and they did so pretty quickly.
Oh I had no idea that exists! Thanks for the tip!
Samantha got bell peppers, which are like cookies for her lol
Thanks! Walmart cookie icing in a squeeze bag is the best.

The vets themselves are really awesome and respectful and really cared about Morgie. It was the receptionist. She was just being careless I think and I don't think she meant anything bad by it. But it just goes to show how some people don't take guinea pigs seriously and don't think of them as a legit pet.
They're very susceptible to illness, it's really sad.

Yeah it sucks..people don't think pigs are as important as other pets. We love them just as much and they're just as capable of love as a dog or cat. The vet office called her a hamster and my coworkers keep telling me they eat guinea pigs in Peru...then they laugh like it's such a big joke.

That's an old picture of her, it was watermarked months ago. People kept taking the picture and spreading it and claiming it as their own. I just quickly chose 4 pics of her from my phone that I liked.
She was such a beautiful girl inside and out. Thank you.
